_comment_deny_context: The first deny block trims the system prompt, not just permissions: ReportFindings is unused here (no skill calls it), ListAgents is dead with disableRemoteControl on, and each Task(<agent>) line drops that row from the agent listing. Delete a Task line to get that agent back. general-purpose and the project agents (slice, slice-fill, wiring, review-axis) stay.
_comment_skillOverrides: user-invocable-only = hidden from the listing, still runs when you type /name. off = hidden everywhere. Delete a line to bring the skill back; the _when note on each says when that is worth doing.
_when_task_flow: user-invocable-only: only you start a ticket run; no skill dispatches to it.
_when_docs_audit: user-invocable-only: only you start a docs rot sweep.
_when_find_skills: off: turn on when you want to search for and install new agent skills.
_when_audit_context: off: turn on when you want a nao context audit (RULES.md, table coverage, data model).
_when_optimize_agent_docs: off: turn on when you want the dotfiles docs rebuilt into a retrieval-optimized knowledge layer.
